events_timeline.description: Mistwood is ceded by treaty to Ashkari Nomads.
Selurian Republic persecutes religious minorities in Ashara Desert (intensity=1.00)
In Sapphire Coast, Elder Walnutgrove founds the Seekers of Sapphire Coast: 14 of 43 people there want freedom to worship in the Faith of Thornwall Confederacy
the Seekers of Sapphire Coast spreads to Mistwood (3 members)
In Mistwood, Queen Talonpeak founds the Commons of Mistwood: 9 of 26 people there want relief from hunger and dues
the Seekers of Sapphire Coast spreads to Ashara Desert (2 members)
the Commons of Mistwood spreads to Ashara Desert (2 members)
In Ashara Desert, Elder Pumicor founds the Ploughmen's League of Ashara Desert: 15 of 18 people there want relief from hunger and dues
the Seekers of Sapphire Coast, 10 strong (11% of the people of Thornwall Confederacy), demands freedom to worship in the Faith of Selurian Republic
